# gt18: console sampler 23 Nov had NpSim26Apply's callees at 2.0 % of the game thread (about 560 host instructions a bone: memory latency). Bit 16 starts the loads of the bone volumes and of the lane's per-bone results in the walk that counts the bones, and of the next bone's physics object and node matrix. A prefetch changes no value (host: det trace and frame hashes identical). A/B against gt18off-d's neighbour run without it (plan MSC_PREFETCH is 0): game ms and the sampler's NpSim26Apply share; keep it off unless it is faster.
